summary: Conducted systematic tuning of optimizer hyperparameters. Found that increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 provides modest improvement (1.011943 vs 1.012347). Further reduced WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.15, achieving best result of 1.011649. Changes to warmdown schedule and embedding LR proved counterproductive. Total improvement over baseline: 0.000698 bpb (0.069%).
